assets.prompt: Create an original polished transparent-background TWO-PROP SPRITE SHEET for BobbyGames Angkor Runner, matching the supplied warm painterly Cambodian-inspired forest trail style. EXACTLY TWO isolated obstacles side by side with clear transparent gutter, fully contained in their own half. LEFT: one substantial fallen hardwood log lying horizontally across a single lane, textured bark, sawn end rings, a little moss and leaves at the feet, low but clearly solid and easy to understand as JUMP obstacle. RIGHT: one low rustic wooden crossbar made of natural timber and leafy branch material, supported by two narrow posts, broad gap beneath the horizontal bar at foot level, clearly a SLIDE-UNDER obstacle, not a solid wall, no sacred architecture. Both face the camera from a slightly raised frontal perspective with their bases aligned on same ground level. Rich volume, believable material, detailed but very clear shape when drawn at 140 pixels. No labels, arrows, coins, people, shadows beyond sprite, extra objects, real temple replicas, logos, flags, background. Transparent alpha.
